newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Philippine Nat'l raises FRCD to $150 mln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Nat'l raises FRCD to $150 mln.

text.p: Philippine National Bank's floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been increased to US$150 million from US$125 million, arranger HSBC Markets said.

The facility, which was launched through the borrower's Hong Kong branch, has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options. The issue was priced at par to float at 65 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 70 basis points.
Arranger HSBC Markets committed US$26 million.
Co-arrangers with US$13 million each are Credit Lyonnais, Fuji International Finance (HK) and JP Morgan Securities Asia.
Co-lead manager PT Bank Negara Indonesia Hong Kong committed US$11 million.
Co-lead managers with US$7 million each are Daiwa Securities HK, IBJ Asia, Nomura International HK and Sakura Finance Asia.
Senior managers with US$5 million each are Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft Singapore and Merrill Lynch International.

Managers with US$3 million each are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro SPA Singapore, Bank Handlowy w Warszawie London, Banque et Caisse d'Epargne de l'Etat, Luxembourg, DIE ERSTE osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank Aktiengellschaft, E.Sun Commercial Bank, Hamburgische Landesbank-Girozentrale Hong Kong, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale, Raiffeisen Zentralbank Osterreich AG, Salomon Brothers, Tat Lee Bank, Thai Farmers Bank and Tokai Asia.
